note: Deterministic workflows ONLY. No Cube-side LLM steps in the demo path — Ember is the only brain. Each entry names the existing production flow or API it wraps.

tools.description: List the approved deterministic workflows the orchestrator may call.
tools.name: list_workflows
tools.returns: Catalog of workflow ids, names, and required inputs.

tools.description: Read live Metatron Watcher status (components up/down, open incidents) from the AIOps console API /api/overview. Read-only, deterministic.
tools.name: get_watcher_status
tools.returns: Component totals and open-incident count, as one sanitised line.

tools.description: Fire a deterministic webhook-triggered Activepieces flow. Requires a human approval token — Ember proposes, a human approves, only then does this unlock.
tools.name: run_workflow

parameters.approval_token: string — issued by the human approval step
parameters.workflow_id: string — one of the catalog ids

tools.returns: Run id and status; results are read back via get_run_status.

tools.description: Poll the result of a fired workflow run.
tools.name: get_run_status
tools.returns: Run status and its deterministic result payload.
